notes.title: Limited Time Free Demo, Unlimited Chaos!
notes.notes: [h1]Hey fighters! [/h1][h3][b]The moment you've been waiting for is almost here, [/b]Amer Fighting Free Demo is available from[b] 1st Oct [/b]to[b] 12th Oct[/b] Get ready to mess around with some cool new features we've been cooking up — stay tuned![/h3][h2]A crazy new grab mechanic so you can pick up players and YEET them![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235616/e510a81faee4dc448d8a9372e393124faf2d1157.gif"][/img][/p][h2]A totally new Boat map to duke it out on.  [/h2][h3]Splash into fights on a colorful cruise deck packed with floaties, pool toys, umbrellas, and plenty of spots to throw hands or friends! Whether you’re slipping by the pool, dodging punches near a beach chair, or launching someone off the top deck, it’s nonstop action with a side of vacation vibes.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235616/e72ec9fce4b2ef055a992515db7a01ad7d2594ed.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235616/b899a76863877828132babec6f88be2bdbd1cd90.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Level up for more rewards!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235616/d1c778308b94fbe5d1461b9ebc099f3e386054f5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every time you level up, you get cool new rewards. Just keep playing, win fights, and you’ll move up in the game. As you reach higher levels, you’ll unlock new characters with their own fun styles. The more you play, the more you get to discover. Leveling up isn’t just about winning, it’s how you become one of the best in Amer: Fighting.[/p]
